title: plugin-charts: a sankey draws its nodes with no labels and its links all one grey; a funnel labels only its last segment; the sankey's omitted-rows footnote is hard-coded English
body:
Filing-gate: ① product defect · reach: the showcase Chart Gallery page, as admin in zh-CN
Reader: objectui triage seat → the lane that owns `packages/plugin-charts` (`AdvancedChartImpl.tsx`, the `sankey` and `funnel` branches)
Duplicate search: semantic search "sankey chart nodes have no labels links grey funnel chart labels only last stage" in objectui, incl. closed → 4 hits: #7148, #7140 (closed, dropped or negative rows), #11417 (closed, a second measure), #13143 (unrelated). None covers labels.

Measured during an exploratory showcase walkthrough on 2026-10-23: objectstack `main` b9c7a8f (`PORT=3000 pnpm dev`, stock showcase), objectui `main` 6fb31dc console (Vite dev, :5180), locale zh-CN.

## What happens

- **Sankey:** the nodes are bare bars with no names, so the chart cannot be read without hovering each one. Every link is the same `muted-foreground` at 25% opacity, so the eye cannot follow a flow.
- **Funnel:** only the last (narrowest) segment shows its label. The others are placed outside the chart area to the right and clipped.
- **Sankey footnote:** "Showing N of M rows — K rows have no VALUE above zero, which a flow cannot draw." is JSX text, not an i18n key, so a zh-CN session reads it in English.

## Where

`packages/plugin-charts/src/AdvancedChartImpl.tsx`:

- `<Sankey … link={{ stroke: 'hsl(var(--muted-foreground))', strokeOpacity: 0.25 }} node={{ fill: 'hsl(var(--chart-1))' }}>`: a plain-object `node` is Recharts' default rectangle, which draws no label, and `link` has no per-source colour.
- `<Funnel …><LabelList position="right" … /></Funnel>`: `right` is outside each trapezoid, and the container leaves no room for it.
- The footnote text is inside the `ChartFootnote` in the same branch.

## Expected

Sankey nodes carry their names, and links take their source node's palette colour. Funnel labels sit inside or beside their segments without clipping. The footnote goes through `t()`.

Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01A48x1XYLTmiM2pgQxsgeKJ
